subject: Awareness: Kai RP8/RP9 generated, new input patterns in exam renderer
body:
FA — FR here, flagging implementation-relevant changes from the Kai exam walkthrough session.

Background: Marcus and FR walked through all 15 questions of RP7 and made targeted upgrades based on real exam error patterns. FR then generated RP8 and RP9 responding to simulated score data. All math verified (27 assertions, 0 failures).

Three implementation patterns to be aware of for GA/the exam renderer:

1. LABELED ± INPUTS: Any question where x^2=k appears (Q6 in RP7/RP8/RP9, Q10 in RP7/RP8/RP9) now has two answer inputs labeled 'Larger value' and 'Smaller value' rather than 'x='. This is intentional — Kai must consciously name both solutions. The renderer needs to support this labeling pattern if it doesn't already.

2. FACTORED FORM TEXT INPUTS (self-graded): Q5 (AC method questions) has Kai write the factored form as a text input before entering roots. Current Q5 instructions say 'Show your factored form.' If the renderer supports a structured text field for intermediate work, this is where it should be used. If not, it is currently self-graded on honor system.

3. MULTI-OUTPUT GRAPH QUESTIONS: RP9 Q12 (downward parabola) has 7 total numeric inputs: vertex x, vertex y, axis of symmetry, x-intercept 1, x-intercept 2, opening direction (up/down dropdown), and intervals. RP7/RP8 Q12 had 5 inputs. This is an expansion — check that the renderer can handle variable-count numeric input groups per question without layout issues.

No action required now unless GA is actively building the exam renderer. Flagging for awareness so these don't land as surprises. Full briefing doc at docs/gr-skill-transfer-briefing.md if you want full context on the pedagogical rationale.
